rows.en: Inside the abandoned <pic(0)><cs(3)>Amaterasu<ce()>, <pt(75,-75,0,1)>a heat signature has been detected.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: We have also confirmed that Neo Zeon combat units are lurking nearby.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: Given this and Char's course, it is reasonable to conclude that Char fled here.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: I want all pilots<mk(-12.5,12.5,1,0)><ar(0,1,0,50)> to infiltrate the <pic(1)><cs(3)>interior<ce()> and search for Char and the E2.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: You'll be slipping right into Char's bosom. One moment's mistake could cost your life.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: Take every care, defeat Char, and wipe the E2 from the face of this world.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: Char has only so many places to go. I think we can trust what Hokushin said.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: We do not know what trump card he may still be hiding.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: But we have come this far. It is time to settle things with Char once and for all.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: To think it would come to this... Just a little more... and after we came this far!
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?
